learningGoals: Observe and describe details found in pictures using simple English sentences. 👁️
Understand and use position words like 'in', 'on', 'under', and 'behind'. 📍
Build everyday vocabulary by identifying objects, people, and actions in a scene. 🗣️
Develop visual literacy by connecting pictures to the words they read. 📖
Answer simple 'What', 'Where', and 'Who' questions based on a visual prompt. ❓
conversationStarters: What is the most interesting thing you see happening in this picture? 🌟
Can you tell me a short story about the people in this drawing? 📚
If you could jump inside this picture, where would you sit and what would you do? ✨
teachingTips: Play an 'I Spy' game with the textbook pictures to help them find specific objects and characters. 🕵️‍♂️
Ask your child to use full sentences when describing what they see, gently correcting their grammar. 🗣️
Use toys around the house to practice position words, like putting a block 'under' a table or 'in' a box. 🧸
Encourage your child to point to the words as they read the labels on the pictures. 👆
Ask open-ended questions that require more than a yes/no answer to encourage speaking practice. 🗨️

funActivities.title: I Spy in the Room 🕵️‍♀️
funActivities.description: Sit in a room and take turns saying 'I spy with my little eye something that is...' and describe the color or position. Guess the object in English.

funActivities.title: Draw and Tell 🎨
funActivities.description: Have your child draw a busy scene, like a park or a market. Ask them to point to things in their drawing and describe them using position words.

funActivities.title: Photo Album Storytime 📸
funActivities.description: Look through a family photo album. Ask your child to read the 'picture' by telling you who is in it, where they are, and what they are doing.
